earnings.title: 55 Water Street
highlights: The Company reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $3.678 billion, an increase of 7% compared to the third quarter of 2025.
Third quarter GAAP net income increased 20% to $1.298 billion and GAAP diluted earnings per share increased 26% to $4.45.
Adjusted net income for the third quarter increased 4% to $1.337 billion and adjusted diluted earnings per share increased 9% to $4.58.
The Company reported revenue of $3.678 billion, which increased 7% year over year.

Operating margin increased 800 basis points and adjusted operating margin increased 60 basis points, driving 26% growth in diluted EPS and 9% growth in adjusted diluted EPS, respectively, year over year.
outlook: The Company continues to expect to repurchase more than $7 billion in shares in total in 2026.
2026 guidance calls for revenue growth of 7.4% to 8.4%, and organic constant currency growth of 7.5% to 8.5%.

Total revenue and organic constant currency revenue are now expected to be higher than the previous guidance ranges of 5.9% to 7.9% and 6.0% to 8.0%, respectively, both driven by higher expected revenue from the Ratings and Indices divisions.
GAAP diluted EPS is expected to be lower than the prior guidance range of $16.35 to $16.60 primarily due to adjustments to expected gain on dispositions, partially offset by higher revenue.

items.heading: Our inability to innovate and compete with new or enhanced products and services of our competitors could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.
Our inability to successfully develop, adapt, or implement new and improved processes and technology could materially adversely impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.

Increased availability of free or relatively inexpensive information sources may materially reduce demand for our products and services and could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.

Artificial Intelligence ("AI") presents new and evolving risks, and our approach to AI may not be successful, which could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.
Our use of open source software could result in litigation or impose unanticipated restrictions on our ability to commercialize our products and services.
Our inability to adequately obtain, protect and maintain our intellectual property and other proprietary rights could impact our competitive position.
